privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How LeMedia uses the information involved in your account, requests and use of this site.
privacy.draft_notice: This notice is a draft. The operator's contact details, legal bases and international transfer arrangements have not yet been confirmed.
privacy.operator.title: Who runs this site
privacy.operator.p1: LeMedia is a personal service for people known to its administrator, who runs the site. For privacy questions, or to ask about your information, contact the administrator through the person who gave you access to the service.
privacy.information.title: Information we use
privacy.information.p1: Account information includes your email address, display name, role and profile picture or avatar settings. If you sign in with a linked provider, LeMedia may receive and store your provider identifier, username, email address and profile picture URL. Where needed for an integration, it may also store an access token.
privacy.information.p2: LeMedia stores your movie and series requests, selected seasons or quality, request status and dates, as well as notifications and links you choose to share. A shared link can be opened by anyone who has it until it expires or is revoked; LeMedia also records the number of views.
privacy.information.p3: The app, its network proxy and security providers may process technical information such as IP address, request time, browser or device information, and error or security logs. Your local password, if you use one, is stored as a hash.
privacy.information.p4: If you enable browser notifications, the service stores a push subscription for that device. Your browser may also store preferences and recent searches locally.
privacy.use.title: How information is used
privacy.use.p1: We use this information to let you sign in, manage your account, process and track requests, show availability, and send updates you choose to receive.
privacy.use.p2: We also use technical and security information to protect the service, prevent abuse, diagnose problems and maintain backups.
privacy.services.title: Services we use
privacy.services.p1: Cloudflare helps deliver and protect the site, including the Turnstile security check. Your browser connects to Cloudflare when you visit and use the check. Cloudflare may process information such as your IP address and device or browser details.
privacy.services.p2: The Movie Database (TMDB) supplies film and series information and artwork. LeMedia sends media queries to TMDB, and your browser may load images directly from TMDB. If you choose Google, GitHub, Plex or another available sign-in provider, that provider processes your sign-in under its own privacy policy.
privacy.services.p3: Requests may be sent to the configured media services, including Radarr, Sonarr or Plex. If enabled, notification services such as Telegram, Discord, email or browser push may receive the information needed to deliver an update, which can include a title, request status and display name.
privacy.services.p4: Some providers may process information outside the UK. Their privacy policies explain their own practices; contact the administrator for details of any safeguards that apply to transfers made through this service.
privacy.storage.title: Cookies and device storage
privacy.storage.p1: LeMedia uses a sign-in cookie and an application version cookie. It also uses browser storage for settings and recent searches, and a service worker may cache application files and artwork. Cloudflare may use its own security cookies or similar technology.
privacy.storage.p2: You can clear this information in your browser or device settings. Doing so may sign you out, remove saved preferences or require the app to download its files again.
privacy.retention.title: How long information is kept
privacy.retention.p1: Account details and request history are kept to operate the service and can be removed by the administrator. Some request records may be removed sooner by cleanup jobs; there is no single automatic expiry for all accounts and request history.
privacy.retention.p2: The app is currently configured to clean up its database logs after 30 days. Cleanup may run later if the job is delayed or disabled. Network proxy and third-party logs may have different retention periods.
privacy.retention.p3: Scheduled backups currently run every six hours and retain the most recent 28 copies, normally about seven days. Copies made separately or kept elsewhere may remain longer. Deleted information can remain in backups until those copies are removed.
privacy.choices.title: Your choices
privacy.choices.p1: You can update your profile and notification preferences in your account. You can unlink a provider when another sign-in method remains, and you can turn off browser notifications in the app or your device settings.
privacy.choices.p2: Contact the administrator if you want to ask about, correct or delete your account information or request a copy. The administrator may need to verify your identity before acting on a request.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.p1: Depending on the law that applies, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict or receive a copy of your personal information, and to object to certain processing. You can raise a concern with the administrator.
privacy.rights.p2: If UK data protection law applies, you can also raise a concern with the Information Commissioner's Office
